title: L'Oréal accelerates in Q3, with growth across all divisions
summary: L'Oréal said Thursday, October 22, its third quarter sales rose by double digits. Sales growth was driven by strong demand across all divisions and regions, including China. The French cosmetics giant, whose brands include Garnier, Lancôme and Maybelline, said its sales came in at 11.6 billion euros (USD 13.0 billion) in the three months to the end of September, handily beating analyst expectations.
